title: Element, class, and ID selectors
learningObjectives: Choose and write maintainable CSS selectors for element, class, and id selectors.

understand.concept: Element selectors match tag names, class selectors begin with a dot and ID selectors begin with #. Prefer reusable classes for styling groups of elements.
understand.whyItMatters: Good selectors target intended elements and keep styles maintainable.
understand.analogy: Selectors are like finding items in a list by their labels or relationships.
understand.analogyLimit: Selectors are not just labels; the document tree, state and specificity also matter.

explain.narrative: Element selectors match tag names, class selectors begin with a dot and ID selectors begin with #. Prefer reusable classes for styling groups of elements.
